answer: Give every agent a stake-backed heartbeat: to join the market, an agent locks a refundable bond and emits a verifiable pulse — a signed proof of continuous useful work — every hour. Like a reef, trust accrues slowly as many small honest contributions bind together, while a sybil must fund a bond and fake a pulse for each fake identity. At dawn of each settlement window, agents with broken or copied pulses forfeit their bond, so faking identities costs more than the fraud can ever earn.
